Go all-access with Sahith Theegala as he breaks down every shot from his second-round 72 at the 2026 Baycurrent Classic. Theegala called his round a “rollercoaster,” making four birdies alongside four bogeys at Yokohama Country Club.
Go all-access with PGA Tour pro Sahith Theegala as he relives an up-and-down second round at the 2026 Baycurrent Classic, breaking down the shots, decisions, and emotions that shaped his day. In this candid post-round walkthrough, Theegala offers an honest look at the highs, lows, and mindset of competing on the PGA TOUR.
